rules.designGoal: Keep Assassin easy to play: one automatic primary combo plus a maximum of four active skill buttons. Move compatible upgrades, procs and conditional mechanics into magical crystals/passives instead of extra buttons.

originsBehavior.rotation: At the unlocked stage, attacks automatically advance through the sequence and loop back to FullBloom after the final hit. The player does not need four separate buttons.

primaryLotusCombo.designNote: Zircon implements these as four separate attacks with short-lived combo states. ORIGINS preserves the ordered combo but collapses it into one automatic evolving primary skill.

crystalCandidates.GhostWalk: Adds the GhostWalk improvement/state when entering Cloak.

cloak.designNote: Cloak remains one active button. Its improvements are crystals rather than additional active skills.

originsBehavior.HellFire: Single-target fire hit with burn/periodic damage foundation.
originsBehavior.FlamingDaggers: Evolves the farm skill into a stronger multi-projectile dagger attack.
originsBehavior.Shredding: Final farm evolution; expand coverage/penetration or multi-hit behavior while keeping the Zircon fire/SP identity.

fireFarm.designNote: FlamingDaggers and Shredding are mechanically very similar in Zircon, so ORIGINS intentionally differentiates them as successive farming evolutions instead of separate buttons.

mobilityExecution.designNote: One mobility/execution button: close on a target and strike, then evolve toward a faster forward burst/line attack. Exact ORIGINS movement tuning remains implementation-specific.

areaClear.designNote: Natural AoE evolution: FourWheels attacks around the Assassin at radius 2; CrescentMoon uses the same basic pattern at radius 3.

FatalBlow.effect: Chance for bonus damage against enemies below 30% HP.

Massacre.effect: On monster kill, converts overkill damage into nearby splash damage; bosses excluded in Zircon.

DualWeaponSkills.effect: Damage bonus while using DualWield weapons.

LastStand.effect: Automatically increases physical defence while below 30% HP.

GhostWalk.effect: Adds the GhostWalk improvement/state to Cloak.

FlameSplash.effect: Special crystal candidate that adds secondary attacks around the primary target instead of becoming another button.

DragonWave.effect: Upgrades FlameSplash damage/coverage; Zircon can expand secondary directions up to eight.

BurningFire.effect: Special crystal candidate: fire attacks can create a persistent burning ground zone/explosion instead of adding another active button.

Chain.effect: Chance/trigger to link nearby non-boss monsters and constrain their separation without requiring a separate Chain button.

ChainOfFire.effect: Advanced Chain crystal. Preserve Zircon progression concept: slow linked targets, share/siphon damage, periodic fire damage, and final death explosion at high tier.

WraithGrip.effect: Optional control crystal applying WraithGrip-like status without adding an active button.

TouchOfTheDeparted.effect: Upgrades WraithGrip with paralysis, following the Zircon dependency.

DragonBlood.effect: Attack proc that applies stackable green poison, up to four stacks in Zircon.

standby.reason: Keep these out of the core Assassin kit to avoid excessive active buttons. They remain available for later crystals, PvP variants, special builds or future classes.

notForCoreUse.designNote: Do not build core ORIGINS Assassin progression around incomplete, unused or effectively stubbed Zircon skills.

finalGameplayShape.complexityGoal: The player should understand the Assassin quickly; depth comes from crystals/passives and evolution, not from managing a large hotbar.
